plugins.name: athanor
plugins.description: Self-sustaining agentic workflow orchestrator — cross-model adversarial planning with thin-leader dispatch. Vendored subset of CE 3.8.3 (33 ce-* skills after v0.11.2 scope-clarification cut) + superpowers 5.1.0 under athanor namespace (athanor identity commitments preserved). Standalone /athanor:lfg runs the pipeline through athanor-native commands. v0.11.3 fixes the Stop hook input-layer parser so the runtime gate documented since v0.7.8 actually runs in production (the v0.7.9 / v0.10.2 / v0.10.3 detection logic is unchanged; only the stdin reader is corrected). Stop hook with multi-script confusables fold + paraphrase regex + conditional/attribution suppression.
